# speckit context score

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Score every project-root LLM-context file (`AGENTS.markdown`, `CLAUDE.markdown`, `llms.txt`) enabled the five-dimension composite quality metric

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit context score [OPTIONS]
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.

## Help

```text
speckit context score --help
```
